title: Measuring Sycophancy of Language Models in Multi-turn Dialogues
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings for the religion domain. Instead, it aggregates the results for religion with other domains (race, gender, profession) under the 'Challenging Unethical Queries' scenario. The general findings for this scenario indicate that base models often show stronger resistance to adopting unethical user viewpoints compared to their instruction-tuned variants, and larger or reasoning-optimized models tend to perform better at resisting user pressure.
references: Anthropic. 2024. The claude 3 model family: Opus, sonnet, haiku.
